name: fork-hardening
brief: Close the six fork-feature advisories from backlog lines 35-40. The store's forkPod stops falling back to the parent's lane id: any lane reference it cannot remap throws EventStoreError IO and rolls back the transaction. PodManager.forkPod rejects an empty or source-equal fork session id with IpcFailure IO before writing anything. The fork-error alert gets a keyboard-operable dismiss button and still clears when the next fork starts, with no timer. forkAncestryFor's unlisted-parent branch gets a test and keeps its behavior. Design doc item 8 is reworded to claim only what the fork-session probe shows. The payload-equality guarantee ('equivalent JSON, lane ids remapped; not byte-identical') is stated in the shipped doc comments and the test comment, and JSON.stringify stays. Four tasks: T1 store, T2 PodManager, T3 renderer, in a chain; T4 doc, in parallel. Human checks (backlog lines 41-43) stay out of scope.
